summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by GSK plc, a foreign private issuer, reporting Director/PDMR shareholdings. It discloses the acquisition of notional American Depositary Shares in Executive Supplemental Savings Plan accounts by a Non-Executive Director and two officers following dividend reinvestment at a price of $49.67 per ADS on May 15, 2026. No board action, transaction consideration, premium, advisor, or structural details are present. This is a standard disclosure of insider dividend reinvestment activity, not a special situation event, so it is classified as None.
